_note: Engine-wide content shared by every industry pack.

autonomyLevels.name: Observe / Assist
autonomyLevels.who: A person does the work; the agent informs and drafts.

autonomyLevels.name: Propose
autonomyLevels.who: The agent proposes; a named approver decides and a person executes.

autonomyLevels.name: Act with approval
autonomyLevels.who: The agent executes after the approver says yes, within catalogued, reversible actions.

autonomyLevels.name: Act and notify
autonomyLevels.who: The agent executes within policy and notifies the owner; the owner can roll back.
autonomyLevels.executes: Catalogued, reversible IT actions within policy

promotionRule: An agent may move up one level after 8 weeks at ≥ 90% acceptance, ≥ 0.9 evaluation score and no policy violations, by decision of the AI governance board. A regression, a policy violation or a drop in evaluation demotes it automatically.

sourceTypes.published: Published third-party source (see the linked publication)
sourceTypes.capgemini-proof: Capgemini proof point (approved for this use)

engagementOptions.name: Assess
engagementOptions.gets: Readiness score, prioritised use cases, value case and target architecture

engagementOptions.name: Pilot
engagementOptions.gets: 1–2 agents on 3–5 data products at L2/L3
engagementOptions.exit: Measured KPI movement and a promotion decision

engagementOptions.name: Scale
engagementOptions.gets: An agent fleet across a domain, the data-product factory and the control plane
engagementOptions.exit: Domain KPIs met; L3/L4 for qualifying (non-OT) agents

engagementOptions.name: Run
engagementOptions.gets: Managed agent operations, evaluation and FinOps
